title: Stage-1 awaiting-membership rule still triplicated despite the view's "single home" contract
evidence:
View header (supabase/migrations/20260731213000_add_inbound_email_sender_state_view.sql): "This view is the SINGLE home of the reminder-series rules — before it existed, the stage-2 gate was mirrored (and drift-prone) across mark/count/list SQL. Consumers read columns, never re-derive". But mark_reminders_for_vacancy.sql still carries: "  AND reminder_sent_at IS NULL
  AND sender_email IS NOT NULL
  AND sender_email <> ''
  AND lower(sender_email) NOT IN (
    SELECT lower(email) FROM application WHERE vacancy_id = $1
  )" and list_awaiting_for_vacancy.sql's `latest` CTE repeats the identical sender_email/NOT IN predicate. The view even exposes `has_unreminded`, yet only count_awaiting_for_vacancy.sql consumes it.
detail: The r1 fix centralised the stage-2 gate (verified: `interval '2 days'` appears only in the view; mark/count/list all read stage2_due), but the underlying who-is-awaiting membership predicate and the stage-1 un-reminded rule still live in three places. Any future change to membership (e.g. excluding withdrawn applications) silently desyncs the stage-1 mark from count/list.
recommended_fix: Point mark_reminders_for_vacancy.sql at the view the same way the stage-2 mark does: `AND lower(sender_email) IN (SELECT sender_email_lc FROM inbound_email_sender_state WHERE vacancy_id = $1 AND has_unreminded)`; have list_awaiting join the view for membership instead of re-deriving the NOT IN filter.

title: month_name helper copied a third time with a third return shape
detail: Repo convention is DRY at 2+ repeats and "Implement completely or defer entirely" — a 'known follow-up' comment with no tracker entry is the prohibited cleanup-later pattern, and three divergent return shapes (Option/Result/String) make the eventual merge harder each time a new caller picks one.
recommended_fix: Either consolidate now into one shared helper (e.g. shared or a date_helpers module, one canonical shape with thin adapters) or add an explicit deferred-work.md entry so the follow-up is tracked rather than comment-only.
